Island 1.1: round 4, designed frames

Round 3's symmetric, book-order layouts with the frames themselves designed: translucency, gradients, colour, shadow, glow, texture. The paper around stays plain. Click one to see it whole, at 1/3 and at 1/20. 23 October 2026.

1

Frosted glass: four translucent discs with an inner gradient, a bright rim and a soft shadow.

2

Watercolour washes: soft rounds fading at their edges, tinted from English blue at (a) to translated lilac at (d).

3

Layered paper-cut: stacked tinted paper rings with shadows between them and a subtle grain.

4

Light and halos: a round pool of light behind each landmark, blue turning lilac along the reading, glowing arrows.

5

Glass lenses: tinted soap-bubble circles; on each line the two overlap, and the overlap is tinted twice.
